## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Update AGENTS.md's Commands section, which still says to run `make test`. The Makefile in this PR no longer has that target, and the guide says these commands are the repository's only checks.

## Changes
The PR renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:18 — comments — Change `make test` to `make check` in Commands — At pr-72, AGENTS.md:18 still says "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." Makefile:6 now defines only `check:` and `lint:`, so that command fails with "No rule to make target 'test'". AGENTS.md:15 in the same file says the Makefile "defines the `check` and `lint` targets." — Anyone following the guide before pushing hits a make error instead of running pytest, and AGENTS.md:20 says this repository has no CI to catch the gap.
